messages:
marco: starting staged rollout v2.4.5 -> canary 7% (eu-north). change window 08:00-10:00 UTC. release notes: https://redwood/release/v2.4.5 :rocket;

deploy-bot: ROLLOUT r-4112 initiated. target=canary:7% eu-north. monitors: p95_latency, 5xx_rate, relevance-f1. logs: /rollouts/r-4112. :robot_face:;

rina: smoke tests passed on canary pods. watching dashboards.

ops_lead: quick callout: watch relevance-f1 on search and any 5xx spikes. autoscaler set to slow ramp.

marco: small bump in 5xx from 0.2% -> 1.1% on a single AZ (az-2) over 6m. not seen in az-1.

infra-bot: alert: az-2 nodepool shows elevated restart rate (2 restarts / 10m). tagging nodepool-az2.

rina: did a tiny eval on recent queries: relevance-f1 dropped 0.83 -> 0.75 for product-search subset (N=60).

marco: logs snippet:
```
[08:14:02] proxy az-2 node-6 req=aa123 status=502
[08:14:03] model-worker node-6 oom_kill pid=2222 mem=91%
[08:14:04] reranker: relevance=0.75 baseline=0.83
```

ops_lead: recommend PAUSE and PIN at 7%. we need an eval across top-200 queries and decide rollback vs infra remediation.

deploy-bot: ACK. pinning rollout id r-4112 at 7%. command: `deploy-bot pin r-4112 --reason "az-2 restarts + relevance drop"` -> done. state=paused_at_7pct.

marco: pin in place. infra, can you cordon az-2 from canary routing?

infra-bot: cordon executed: nodepool-az2 excluded from canary routing. canary traffic now on az-1 and az-3.

rina: triggered eval ev-2207 with prompt_set=top-200-product-search. ETA ~11m.

eval-bot: ev-2207 queued. expected finish ~11m.

ops_lead: rollback plan ready if ev-2207 shows relevance delta >= 5pp or 5xx >1.5% sustained 10m: `deploy-bot rollback r-4112 --to v2.4.4 --notify cs-team@redwood`.

marco: also FYI release notes had a wrong model-variant tag for embeddings. not related maybe but flagged.

eval-bot: ev-2207 done. results: top-200 pass_rate=88% baseline=94% delta=-6pp. flagged as regression per policy. full report: https://redwood/evals/ev-2207

rina: that's outside the threshold. recommend rollback. 5xx stabilized after cordon but relevance regression persists.

ops_lead: consensus = ROLLBACK. marco, run rollback and notify CS.

marco: deploy-bot, run rollback now. drafting CS note: "We paused v2.4.5 canary after a relevance regression on product search; reverting to v2.4.4 while we investigate."

deploy-bot: executing: `deploy-bot rollback r-4112 --to v2.4.4 --notify "cs-team@redwood" --reason "relevance-regression"`

deploy-bot: rollback complete. traffic reverted to v2.4.4. state=rolled_back. audit: rollback by marco at 4112223446.

infra-bot: created ticket INF-2277 to investigate nodepool-az2 restarts and memory tuning.

ops_lead: post-rollback checklist: collect failing queries from ev-2207, reproduce in staging with az-2 config, vet the model-variant tag discrepancy in release notes, and schedule follow-up at 09:30 UTC.

cs-team: customer note queued. closing rollout thread until remediation validated. :white_check_mark:
